note: Base-game body facts (names, UV boxes and pixel regions only; no game data). Keys are .mesh paths, lowercase. removable: named parts a derived body can drop (any triangle with a vertex mostly on bone whose UV centroid lies in uv_px of a tex-px texture). hair_region: the diffuse's hair (x0 y0 x1 y1 [tex]) skinned additions use when no hair swatch fits. SPEC Track R. areas: named texture areas as bone groups for the generic 28-bone skeleton (a body may override them under its own "areas"); a triangle belongs to the area of most of its vertices' dominant bones (textures.areas); recipes target them as area:<name>. Areas are listed broad before narrow (arms before forearms, legs before shins): finishes apply in this order.
